results.name: Jersey Soft Play
results.notes:
Re-checked directly on 2026-11-12. Operating: live site with 2026 copyright, current 2026-09-04 imagery, and third-party listings (findpartyrental, softplayrentalprices) quoting an active Google listing with 4.8 stars / 22 reviews and 9 AM-6 PM daily hours. Type is soft-play equipment rental (mobile, indoor), not an excluded type. Top issues 1-5 all hold: (1) rendered DOM has 0
elements on / and /booking/; both 'Start Inquiry' links are target=_blank to jerseysoftplay214395.hbportal.co, so no on-site form exists; (2) 'East Brunswick' and five nearby town names appear in the body text of none of the six pages, and /locations/ lists only North/Central/South Jersey + Jersey Shore; (3) no hours and no date/availability control anywhere (no date input, calendar element or iframe), and the booking page says dates are 'held after the quote'; (4) no review, testimonial or star text on any page although external listings show 4.8/22; (5) confirmed mismatch - /packages/ says XL bounce house 7.5 x 7 x 6 ft (big-bounce add-on $200) while the HoneyBook form offers 'XXL Bounce House (10ftL x 10ftW x 11.5ftH) $200', and the form copy contains 'expereince'. Opportunity evidence holds too: a single LocalBusiness JSON-LD (name, url, email, telephone, areaServed 'New Jersey', sameAs Instagram, description - no address, hours, priceRange or Offer); robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with only /balloon_menu.pdf disallowed, sitemap-index declared and sitemap-0.xml has 7 URLs; the HoneyBook form is 60 inputs with required-field text and a reCAPTCHA, followed by a manual 'Review quote' step. Two extra findings that reinforce issue 5: the HoneyBook add-on list also omits the attendant and extra-play-time add-ons the site advertises and adds an unlisted $15 extra-hopper option. Two small imprecisions, neither affecting a top issue or opportunity: the gallery has 12 setup photos (14 tags including 2 logo copies), not 14 gallery images; and the leftover /gallery.html is a noindex meta-refresh stub into /gallery/ rather than a blank 'Gallery' page (it still returns 200). Mobile check at 390 px: no horizontal overflow on / or /booking/, header collapses to a Menu button, tel: links present in body and footer, so phone_layout 'good' and click_to_call true stand. Page basics hold: one H1 and a unique meta description per page, and no page title names a town. Agent-readiness marks (findable 2, answerable 2, bookable 2) and scores (gap 4, ability 2, ease 4, evidence 4) are reasonable as written; no score changes proposed.

data_gaps: Google Business Profile could not be opened first-hand (Google bot check); rating 4.8 / 22 reviews / 9 AM-6 PM daily hours were confirmed only via third-party listings that attribute them to Google (findpartyrental.com, softplayrentalprices.com, localitybiz.com).
Instagram follower count (373) was not re-verified; no usable public Instagram page was served in this session, so that size signal is unconfirmed.

Whether East Brunswick is the business's home base is supported only by third-party listings (which show an East Brunswick street address); the site publishes no address or town, so the 'home town' framing is an inference from listings, not from the business's own site.
